Frosty-ccino was not found at the Columbus restaurant and is not listed as a menu item; a morning re-check is needed. Calorie ranges (calories_low/calories_high) are shown exactly as on Wendy's site where no single figure is given. Where Wendy's own pages disagree, both figures are shown and flagged, never reconciled.
